item.title: New Home Christmas Ornament Gift, Closing Gift Ceramic Ornament with Teal Star Key and Merry Christmas by CowlingTradingCo
item.description: 16.99 USD A round ceramic ornament made as a Christmas gift for a new home. It suits a realtor or lender thanking clients after closing, and it works just as well for friends and family welcoming a new homeowner at the holidays. The art shows an old-fashioned house key. A large five-point star in dark teal forms the bow of the key, with a thick straight shaft and two blocky teeth below it. Two small mustard leaves and three round brick red berries sit where the star meets the shaft. The words Merry Christmas run in one centred line of brick red type under the key. This is a ready-made design, and every ornament in the pack carries the same artwork. It is a simple way to mark a housewarming, a closing day or a first Christmas in a new house. Designed by the shop owner. Produced and shipped by our print partner, Printify. Design created with AI assistance from original prompts.

item.title: First Christmas New Home Doormat, Christmas Housewarming Gift Welcome Mat with Green Wreath and Little House by CowlingTradingCo
item.description: 34.00 USD A first-Christmas gift for a new home. This 18 x 30 inch polyester doormat suits a housewarming, a closing day or a realtor's thank-you to new homeowners. The art shows a large round wreath of chunky deep-green leaves with cream berries and a red ribbon bow on the left of a mustard-gold background. Inside the wreath is a small cream house with a steep gable roof, a red door and a green chimney. On the right, bold green block capitals read "First Christmas New Home" in two stacked lines. This is a ready-made design, and every mat has the same artwork. It is a cheerful way to welcome the first holiday season in a new house. Designed by the shop owner.
